q: How large is the ADEETIE scheme, and will more clusters be added?
title: ADEETIE budget and phase 2 plans
short: ADEETIE has a total outlay of Rs 1,000 crore over FY 2025-26 to FY 2027-28: Rs 875 crore for interest subvention, Rs 50 crore for audits and Rs 75 crore for hand-holding. BEE plans a second phase of about 100 more clusters after the first 60.
audience: Industry associations, lenders and MSMEs outside the first 60 clusters

ul: Rs 50 crore: investment grade energy audits.
Rs 75 crore: hand-holding and implementation support.

sections.h: What BEE expects it to mobilise
ul: About Rs 9,000 crore of energy efficiency investment.
About Rs 6,750 crore of MSME lending.
Phase 2: about 100 additional clusters, based on learnings from phase 1.
Each project is tracked with a unique project ID in the scheme's MIS run by the project management unit.

sections.h: If your cluster is not yet listed
p: Ask your association to register interest with BEE, and build your baseline now. A cluster that already has audited energy data is easier to bring into the next phase.

senseible: Senseible keeps each unit's energy baseline from its own bills, which an association can use to show a cluster's energy intensity when it asks to be included.

sources.label: BEE, ADEETIE scheme booklet (clusters, technologies, process, FAQs)
